page.overview:
Who is Rolling Logan?

Rolling Logan is an army commander of the Majiatsuka Kingdom. He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Rolling Logan is a big, muscular man with tanned skin, large thick lips, and curly dark-colored hair that reaches to his shoulders. He wears a long yellow cape with purple lining held with a brooch, a black pair of briefs, leather boots, and a pair of red gloves.

He has a torso and arms that appear to be rather disproportionate compared to his legs.

He is a brutal man as he enjoyed crushing his opponents. In the anime, he is sadistic and hungry for positive attention, bragging about how he was going to crush Rebecca just to receive cheers from the audience who despised her.
